description: Pause campaign. Pause an active campaign, or a ready campaign that accepts properties. Properties added while it is paused wait at step 1 until it is resumed. Mail already submitted to the vendor will still be delivered. An ended campaign cannot be paused. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.
